name: Q&D Wire Cable Assembly Inc.
old_description: Q&D Wire Cable Assembly is a Contract Manufacturing Company.  Located in Hillsboro, Oregon just outside of Portland in heart of the
about:
Q&D Wire Cable Assembly Inc. operates in Hillsboro, Oregon, in the region known as the Silicon Forest. The company's plastic molding heritage traces back over 50 years to a spin-off from Tektronix, while its cable assembly and box-build services have been offered since 2008. The business relocated to its current Hillsboro facility in 2011, situated across from the Hillsboro Airport with easy access to Highway 26. Ownership structure and founders are not publicly disclosed.

The company provides contract manufacturing services spanning custom wire and cable assemblies, electrical and mechanical box builds, plastic injection/compression/transfer molding, and ECN rework and fulfillment. Cable capabilities cover wire sizes from 14 to 32 AWG, including coax and ribbon cable, with hand and semi-automatic crimping, lead-free soldering, epoxy potting, and 100% electrical testing. Plastic molding runs on automatic, semi-automatic, and hand presses up to 150 tons, producing parts up to 12 ounces in a range of thermoplastics and thermosets. Rework services address PCB component replacement, mechanical modifications, and packaging changes, with fulfillment for expedited shipping. The shop focuses on high-mix, low-to-medium volume production, from prototype through production runs.

Customers span aviation, industrial, consumer, medical, robotics, aerospace, military, sensors, and UAV/UAS sectors. Distributors such as TTI and Heilind Electronics, along with OEMs including LightSpeed Technologies, Forest Dental, Engle Dental Systems, and Warn Industries, have cited the company's responsiveness, quality, and supply-chain reliability.

Q&D positions itself on "Quality and Delivery" — the basis of its name — emphasizing process-focused, documented workflows, lean manufacturing, and a local alternative to offshore assembly. The firm highlights its experienced new-product-introduction staff who act as an extension of customer engineering teams, AS9100D certification, and a supply chain stocked with major connector brands to reduce lead times.

name: QB Studios-a julsdesign company
old_description: We’re faster, friendlier, and more fun than your average branding agency.
about:
Based in Ankeny, Iowa, QB Studios operates as a combined creative design and custom apparel operation. The business traces its roots to the merger of julsdesign, inc. and QB Studios Custom Apparel, forming a single team that handles branding, design, and decorated apparel under one roof. The company states it has been in the industry for more than 30 years.

The studio provides creative design services including logos, brand refreshes, publications, and tradeshow materials. On the production side, it decorates apparel — tees, hoodies, hats, jackets — using Direct to Film (DTF), vinyl (solid colors, glitter, foil), printing, and embroidery. It also sources and brands a wide range of promotional products such as drinkware and desk accessories, and sets up custom webstores for clients. All work is described as being done in-house.

Clients include marketing teams at companies like JC Toland, small businesses such as Happy DSM and Uptown Ankeny, organizations like the SBAIA, and individual customers seeking personalized gifts. The company serves industries ranging from corporate branding and event marketing to local business promotion and personal gifting.

QB Studios positions itself as a faster, friendlier alternative to traditional agencies, emphasizing "everything under one roof" and "real humans who get you." It highlights fast turnarounds, amazing designers, and killer designs as its core differentiators, aiming to function as an extension of the client's team without the overhead.

name: QSR Steel Corporation
old_description: QSR Steel is an exceptional one-stop, full service structural steel company based in Hartford, CT offering everything from steel buildings to stairs and railings.
about:
QSR Steel Corporation is a structural steel and miscellaneous metals fabricator headquartered in Hartford, Connecticut. The company was founded in 2000, initially focusing on miscellaneous metals before expanding into structural steel fabrication in response to customer demand. It remains privately held, with Glenn Salamone serving as president.

The firm operates two fabrication facilities where it produces structural steel and miscellaneous metal components such as architectural canopies, mezzanines, bollards, ladders, stairs, and railings. In-house detailing, project management, and estimating teams use building information modeling (BIM) and CNC-driven processing machines to translate 3D models directly to the shop floor. QSR also maintains its own erection crews, allowing it to control fabrication through installation without third‑party subcontractors.

QSR serves commercial, industrial, educational, retail, and municipal construction markets across New England. Recent projects include the ShopRite supermarket in Cromwell, the Cheney Bennett Pedestrian Bridge in Manchester, the William Johnston School, and the Margaret B. Mack Apartments in New Haven. Clients range from general contractors and building owners to public entities such as the Town of Darien.

The company emphasizes that its integrated fabrication‑and‑erection model eliminates coordination delays and quality‑control issues, particularly on renovation projects where existing conditions demand rigorous safety and rigging expertise. QSR holds AISC certification for structural steel fabrication and has earned multiple safety awards from the Connecticut Association of Builders and Contractors, as well as recognition on the Top 5000 Fastest Growing Companies list.

about:
Quality Electrical Systems operates from West Jordan, Utah, where it has built a large-scale electrical equipment manufacturing operation over more than 30 years. The company runs a 350,000-square-foot production facility alongside a 75,000-square-foot inventory warehouse in the same city. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The firm produces custom electrical equipment including switchgear, power distribution centers (PDCs), and variable frequency drives (VFDs). Its manufacturing footprint supports OEM contracts with major international brands such as GE/ABB, Yaskawa, Danfoss, and TMEIC. The facility handles both production and warehousing for global shipment.

Primary end markets include data centers, oil and gas, water and wastewater treatment, and mining. Products ship to customers worldwide from the Utah facilities. The company serves both OEM partners and end users in heavy industrial sectors.

QES emphasizes design leadership, stating it continuously evolves its designs to meet customer requirements and the latest industry specifications. The company also highlights its rapid expansion as a source of professional growth for its team, positioning itself as an innovator in industrial electrical systems.

name: Qcells USA Inc. _ Eagle Plant (Dalton)
old_description: Providing homeowners the products and solutions necessary to take control of their energy costs.
about:
Qcells USA Inc. operates the Eagle Plant in Dalton, Georgia. The facility is part of Qcells' U.S. manufacturing footprint, though the plant's founding year and original ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

The plant produces solar photovoltaic modules for residential, commercial, industrial, and utility-scale projects. Qcells emphasizes its American manufacturing heritage and states that its advanced production process prevents hot spots, ensuring safety and reducing yield loss. Specific facility size, headcount, and annual volume figures are not published.

The company serves three primary segments: residential homeowners seeking to control energy costs, commercial and industrial clients including businesses and government agencies, and utility-scale projects expanding electricity generation capacity. Customer stories cited on the website include homeowners Laurel Passera and Justin Fox, and installer DPI Solar.

Qcells positions its U.S. manufacturing as a differentiator, citing a strong heritage in quality and innovation and a No. 1 market-share ranking in the United States. The company also highlights its UL and IEC certification by TÜV Rheinland on next-generation solar technology as a mark of product reliability.

about:
Qorvo Inc. is a wireless semiconductor company headquartered in Greensboro, North Carolina, founded in 2015. The company employs between 5,000 and 9,999 people and operates U.S.-based manufacturing facilities for its RF solutions and foundry services.

Qorvo designs and manufactures RF solutions, wireless chipsets, and switches for mobile, infrastructure, and aerospace/defense markets. It also provides GaN and GaAs foundry services, including advanced packaging, die preparation, and space screening, integrating process, packaging, and test to deliver qualified hardware from design through production.

The company serves automotive, consumer, defense and aerospace, industrial and enterprise, infrastructure, and mobile industries. Customer examples cited include Pozyx for dairy farm productivity, Lockheed Martin for defense capabilities, and Budweiser Budvar for logistics challenges.

Qorvo emphasizes control at the process level to enable system-level innovation, offering a single path from RF design to qualified hardware that reduces iteration cycles and execution risk. Its U.S. manufacturing base supports space-screened components for high-reliability applications.

name: Quabbin Wire & Cable Co Inc
about:
Quabbin Wire & Cable Co. Inc. is based in Ware, Massachusetts, where it designs and manufactures wire and cable solutions. The company’s founding year and ownership structure are not disclosed in the available sources.

The company specializes in stranded data cable, harsh-environment Ethernet, power and control, and multiconductor electronic constructions. It operates two dedicated production plants — one focused on Ethernet cable and the other on general-purpose cable — to maximize efficiency and maintain tight tolerances. Quabbin also develops low-temperature thermoplastic shielded and unshielded cables, and offers a DataMax® line of CMP-rated patch cables rated to 105 °C. Engineering consultation and sales support are available to assist with connector selection and UL certification questions.

Quabbin’s products serve automation and harsh-environment applications, commercial data communications, digital AV and lighting control systems, and general-purpose wiring needs. The company’s cable finder and inventory tools help customers locate stocked items by application or specification.

Quabbin emphasizes performance beyond compliance, citing rigorous testing that exceeds industry standards, a commitment to on-time delivery and competitive pricing, and domestic manufacturing. The company has been featured on the Discovery Channel and promotes its USA-made status as a core differentiator.

name: Quad 4 Plastics
old_description: produces high-quality products with engineering, design and manufacturing expertise.
about:
Quad 4 Plastics operates from Elkhart, Indiana, where it runs two production plants and a distribution warehouse. The company specializes in custom plastic injection molding and thermoforming, serving customers across the United States.

Its capabilities span precision injection molding, plastic thermoforming, vacuum forming, insert molding, and CNC trimming, supported by in-house tooling, finishing, and design assistance that takes concepts from sketch to CAD/CAM models. Assembly, packaging, and fulfillment services extend the offering through a single-source model.

The company serves industries including construction furniture, LPG and NH3 equipment, electronics, marine, recreational vehicles, automotive, and general furniture manufacturing. Customers range from national brands to smaller OEMs seeking medium- to heavy-gauge thermoplastic parts.

Quad 4 emphasizes a partnership approach built on more than two decades of experience, highlighting process integrity, cost reduction, and continuous improvement as differentiators. The firm states that its processes safeguard product quality while lowering production costs, and it aims to deliver globally competitive, innovative manufacturing solutions for customers of all sizes.

name: Quality Cable Contractors, Inc.
old_description: QCCI specializes in commercial low-voltage projects including offices, hospitality, multifamily, aviation, and municipal facilities. Contact us to discuss your specific project requirements.
about:
Quality Cable Contractors, Inc. (QCCI) is an Orlando, Florida-based low-voltage systems contractor serving Central Florida. The company is licensed and insured in the state to perform communications construction and low-voltage work.

QCCI designs, installs, tests, and supports structured cabling, fiber optic backbones, wireless access points, security and surveillance systems, CATV, CCTV, business phone systems, intercom and paging systems, and integrated network infrastructure. Its process follows four phases: assess, design, install, and support, with services including fiber termination, splicing, OTDR testing, and ongoing maintenance.

The contractor works across commercial offices, education, aviation, hospitality, multifamily, and municipal or public facilities. Notable projects include voice, data, CATV, wireless, IP camera, and fiber installations for the Greater Orlando Aviation Authority, and voice, data, CATV, paging, and fiber terminations for Orange County Public Schools. Rosen Hotels & Resorts is also listed as a client.

QCCI emphasizes its licensed and insured status, industry-certified technicians, on-time and on-budget delivery, cutting-edge technology, safety and code compliance, and proven field experience. The company offers complimentary estimates and site consultations and promotes sustainable practices through its QCCI Green initiative.

name: Quality Manufacturing Services Inc
old_description: QMS is a full-service Electronics Manufacturing Services provider, located in Central Florida’s technology hub. Founded in 1995 and emerging as the region’s premier
about:
Quality Manufacturing Services Inc. (QMS) operates from a 52,000-square-foot facility in Lake Mary, Florida, within Central Florida's technology corridor. The company was founded in 1995 and is structured as an employee-owned ESOP corporation.

QMS delivers full-service electronics manufacturing, including PCB assembly (both surface-mount and through-hole), engineering support, testing, design for manufacturability/quality/test (DFM/DFQ/DFT), new product introduction, program management, rapid prototyping, and repair depot services. The plant runs automated SMT lines capable of placing 01005 packages, nitrogen-purge reflow, X-ray inspection, a PVA conformal-coating line, and a Takaya APT-1600 flying-probe tester. Statistical process control with real-time data collection across ten monitoring points underpins production.

The company serves industrial, military, medical, networking, entertainment, transportation, unmanned/UAV, traffic-management, and life-safety markets. Reference customers cited include a defense contractor, a building security systems manufacturer, and an electrical test equipment manufacturer.

QMS emphasizes its employee-ownership culture as a driver of accountability and continuous improvement. A "Fast Track" program compresses cycle times without sacrificing quality, and the firm positions itself as a long-term partner from concept through end-of-life support.
